encoding.notes: Hand-specified instruction bytes independent of the production token table. Print=0x0476, integer=0x003e, *=0xffe2. Source is a readable equivalent, not an AMOS export.

evidence.notes: When both operand magnitudes are below 65536, the quick MULU path returns a 32-bit result without overflow checks. Otherwise the slow path checks the unsigned product against 0x7fffffff before restoring sign. These expectations record interpreter source behavior and still need AMOS execution comparison.
